title: NuGet repository settings
description: The nuget member of a repository document (R-REPO-004). A member lists the classes it applies to in x-trove-classes; a member of another class is refused as not applicable.

deleteMode.description: What the protocol DELETE of a package does (R-NUGET-007, Q-NUGET-1): unlist keeps the version in the flat container and downloadable, delete removes it and writes its tombstone. A delete through the management API, the UI or /files/ is always a hard delete.

forwardSearch.description: Forward the search and autocomplete requests of this remote to the upstream's search resource (R-NUGET-016, Q-NUGET-4). false answers from the packages the remote has cached.
